reviewSignGuide.title: Review Us Sign Maker: Print a Scan-to-Review or Follow-Us QR Sign
reviewSignGuide.subtitle: Make a counter sign with QR codes for Google reviews, Instagram or Facebook follows, Zomato ratings and more. Free, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.
faq: Is the Review Us Sign Maker free?
Yes. It is free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it. The sign is made on your own device.
Which places can the QR code open?

Google review, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Zomato, Swiggy, TripAdvisor, Justdial, Google Maps directions, an online store or marketplace page, an app page, your website, a menu, Telegram, LinkedIn, or any other web address. Pick the place and the tool shows how to find that link.
Can I put more than one QR code on a sign?

Yes. Add up to four codes, each with its own place and a short label under it, for example Google review, Instagram, WhatsApp and menu. With one code the sign is bigger and easiest to scan. With four, each code is smaller, so print on A5 or larger when you can.
How does the stand-up tent work?

The tent layout prints two strips on one A4 page. Cut along the marks, fold each strip on the dashed line and stand it on the counter. The back half is printed upside down on purpose, so both faces read upright and every QR code works.
Where do I find my review or profile link?

Open your page or profile in the app or website, use Share and copy the link. For Google, open your Business Profile and look for the option to get more reviews. The names of buttons change over time. For Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Telegram you can type a handle like @mycafe, and for WhatsApp a phone number.
Should I show a star rating, review count or follower count?

It is optional and you can switch it off. A starter shows sample figures so you can see the layout, and a warning reminds you to replace them. Type only your real figures and update them when they change. A sign with old or made-up numbers can mislead customers.
Can I offer a discount or a gift for a review?

Google asks businesses not to offer rewards in exchange for reviews, and to invite reviews from all customers, not only happy ones. Other sites have their own rules, so check them. Keep the sign simple and honest.
Are my details uploaded or saved on a server?

No. The business name, links and logo stay on your device and the sign is made in your browser. {{siteName}} does not receive them. Your last settings are remembered on this device only, and Start again clears them.

sections.heading: What the Review Us Sign Maker does
paragraphs: The Review Us Sign Maker turns a link into a printed sign with a QR code. A customer points their phone at it and lands on your Google review box, your Instagram or Facebook page, your Zomato listing, a WhatsApp chat or any page you choose. It suits cafes, salons, clinics, hotels, shops and any place with a counter or table.

Pick a starter, choose where the QR code goes, add your business name, and the preview shows the sign at once. You can put up to four codes on one sign, add a small logo beside your name and, if you want, a star rating or follower count.

sections.heading: Getting a sign that works
paragraphs: Print on clean paper at Actual size, and keep each QR code large and flat. Avoid glossy lamination that reflects light, because glare is the most common reason a code will not scan. Test every code with two different phones before you put the sign out.
Use the stand-up tent for counters and tables, and the A5 or A4 size for a frame on a wall. One code per sign is the easiest to scan. If you put four codes on one sign, choose A5 or larger.

sections.heading: Private, honest reviews
paragraphs: Everything is made on your device, so your link and logo are not uploaded. The tool only draws the sign and the QR code.
Ask every customer for a review in the same way, and do not offer gifts or discounts for them. Real, mixed reviews are more trusted than a wall of perfect ones.
